headlines.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous’ penalties on companies that build data centers overseas
headlines.description: President Trump plans to restrict U.S. companies from building data centers overseas — another example of his embrace of AI infrastructure most people oppose.

headlines.title: Trump says recent tech outages 'all separate events' and 'bad things happen' with upgrades
headlines.description: President Trump said the various widespread technical outages over the past week across multiple companies are "all separate." He emphasized that last week's federal ground stop was "different" because the technology is "ancient" and needs to be replaced.

headlines.title: Trump says Putin 'clearly expressed' a desire to end Russia-Ukraine war by diplomatic means
headlines.description: President Trump spoke about his "very good talks" with Russian President Vladimir Putin, saying he thinks "there’s a real good chance" that an end to the war can be reached.

headlines.title: Trump details various trade deals with Southeast Asian countries after summit
headlines.description: President Trump addressed economic partnerships and commercial deals developed from the ASEAN summit. The president said that one agreement is for Philippine Airlines to purchase 20 new Boeing 787 Dreamliners with General Electric engines.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Zohran Mamdani tears Achilles while playing soccer against NYC press corps
headlines.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani will be hobbling in a walking boot for at least the next six weeks, saying he forgot that he’s on the doorstep of middle age and tore his Achilles while playing soccer.

headlines.title: White House national cyber director is leaving the administration after series of tech outages
headlines.description: Sean Cairncross has played a key role in crafting AI policy for the Trump administration. His immediate replacement is Kirsten A. Davies.

headlines.title: Senate passes bill simplifying permitting rules to build in America, sending it to House
headlines.description: The Senate voted 62-33 on Thursday night to pass a sweeping bill to simplify and overhaul permitting rules for energy and infrastructure projects.

headlines.title: Justice Department seeks dismissal of its lawsuit in Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: The Trump administration had sought to block certification of the election results if Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan lost. Democrat Mary Peltola won the race.

headlines.title: Trump’s pick for agency providing election security says Jan. 6 was not an attack
headlines.description: The nominee selected by President Donald Trump to lead the agency tasked with protecting elections in the U.S. refused Thursday to answer who won the 2020 presidential election or call the riot on Jan. 6, 2021, “an attack.”

headlines.title: Trump’s symbolic summit: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Andrea Mitchell dives into the fallout from President Donald Trump’s trilateral meeting in China.

headlines.title: Trump gives posthumous pardon to baseball’s Pete Rose, who pleaded guilty to tax evasion
headlines.description: The baseball great, who died in 2024, pleaded guilty to federal tax evasion charges in 1990 and had been banned from the sport for betting on games.
